messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick announcement

Daniel Park is joining Redwood Inference as Sr. Director, Cross-Functional Operations, start date Aug 1. This role will centralize escalation playbooks across Platform, Runtime, and SRE. We'll run a short internal-only candidate window for one Principal Program Manager (L5) to join his team. Details below.

Elena (CEO): Welcome Daniel! This should streamline incident handoffs and postmortem ownership. Appreciate folks prioritizing transparency during the change.

Daniel Park: Hi team
Looking forward to jumping in. Week 1 priority: meet incident leads, read last 6 months of postmortems, and map current escalation paths. I'll run office hours the week of Aug 5.

Omar (Eng Manager - Platform): For the Principal PM backfill, internal window open through Apr 14. Ideally someone with program experience running cross-team playbooks and incident automation. Apply if interested.

Lina (Talent): Internal application link: <https://company.internal/hiring/principal-pm-ops>. Please attach a one-line summary of a cross-team program you led. Internal window closes Apr 14 23:59 PT.

Sofia (Product Ops): Happy to co-interview for program management and will share the current escalation matrix. We should also include one behavioral question about runbook ownership.

Ravi (SRE): I can cover a 4-week rotation for incident coordination while Daniel ramps if that helps. Also willing to document the current alert ownership table.

Anita (People Ops Bot): Created calendar events: "Daniel intro
All-hands" (Aug 2) and "Principal PM hiring panel" (Apr 20). Invitations sent to Platform, Runtime, SRE, Product Ops.

Maya (People Ops): Action items recap:
- Lina: open internal L5 window + application link (due Apr 14)
- Omar & Sofia: hiring rubric + panel members (by Apr 16)
- Daniel: publish 1-page escalation roadmap and office hours (by Aug 1)
- Ravi: provisional rotation for incident coordination (confirmed)
- People Ops: update org chart and migration note (by Apr 18)

If you plan to apply or nominate someone internally, DM Lina. Please react with :wave: if you saw this.
